zones.title: Gateway
zones.subtitle: The public entry point into the Hyperion ecosystem.
zones.purpose: Route visitors into the public zone without exposing private operator authority.
zones.notesForFrontend: Keep this as the portal gateway, not a generic landing-page hero.

zones.title: Systems
zones.subtitle: A public map of Hyperion systems and boundaries.
zones.purpose: Expose system shape, access posture, and public routes without leaking consoles, memory, or control surfaces.
zones.notesForFrontend: System cards should be data-driven and show declassified posture only.

zones.title: Studio
zones.subtitle: Commercial and creative production lanes.
zones.purpose: House Card Studio, identity artifacts, field reports, client-facing artifacts, proposal templates, ordering flows, and future studio products.
zones.notesForFrontend: Card Studio is a room in the portal, not an orphan microsite.

zones.title: Field
zones.subtitle: Real-world IT, service, hardware, and deployment work.
zones.purpose: Route site work, hardware installs, workstation deployments, closeout reports, client work posture, and field intake.
zones.notesForFrontend: Keep field work inquiry-led until service terms and support boundaries are explicit.

zones.title: Doctrine
zones.subtitle: The public philosophy behind the system.
zones.purpose: Publish public essays and doctrine around continuity, local-first custody, governed AI, memory, field execution, and state exposure.
zones.notesForFrontend: Doctrine can be editorial, but should not imply private capability access.

zones.title: Access
zones.subtitle: Public request, download, support, and onboarding lanes.
zones.purpose: Collect public-safe paths for beta downloads, request forms, demos, contact routes, field job requests, Card Studio ordering, public build links, and onboarding.
zones.notesForFrontend: Forms are public-safe intake models only. No sensitive external service is wired without approval.

zones.title: Status
zones.subtitle: Declassified public posture.
zones.purpose: Show public-safe release lanes, known gaps, restricted/private labels, build posture, and service availability without private telemetry.
zones.notesForFrontend: This is public posture, not live telemetry.

rooms.title: Card Studio
rooms.subtitle: Identity Fabrication / Smart Business Card Lane
rooms.purpose: Compose public identity artifacts, digital cards, physical NFC card previews, and operator-reviewed order requests.
rooms.fulfillmentNotes: Payment and fulfillment move through operator-reviewed Shopify draft invoices. No public cart or checkout is live.

rooms.title: Build Archive
rooms.subtitle: Public field artifact archive
rooms.purpose: Show completed builds and field artifacts without exposing client telemetry or private service notes.

systems.name: CHR0N.OS
systems.description: Local-first archival intelligence for files that need custody, provenance, memory, and recovery workflows.
systems.publicSummary: Public beta for archive intake, provenance-preserving copy workflows, file/context inspection, chronological sorting, and search-oriented organization.
systems.authorityBoundary: Public download links are allowed. Private CHR0N consoles, internal build infrastructure, governed memory commits, and sensitive logs are not exposed.

systems.name: Mnem.OS
systems.description: Memory and continuity authority for long-horizon context, snapshots, priors, histories, archives, and recall structures.
systems.publicSummary: Public shape can be described. Private memory and governed commits are not public.
systems.authorityBoundary: No private memory, vaults, operator state, or governed memory commits are exposed.

systems.name: Hyperion Nest
systems.description: Publicly described as an operator-gated coordination and model-depot lane.
systems.publicSummary: Restricted system. Public can see shape only.
systems.authorityBoundary: No live agent deployment controls, model acquisition authority, or council execution surfaces are public.

systems.name: Hyperion Connect
systems.description: Connector, relay, and bridge posture for local systems and adjacent runtimes.
systems.publicSummary: Public can see the bridge concept and restricted posture, not the control bus.
systems.authorityBoundary: No remote command surfaces, private relay telemetry, pairing secrets, or device command controls are public.

systems.name: ARG.OS
systems.description: A reasoning and negotiation-facing lane for contracts, arguments, and structured positions.
systems.authorityBoundary: No private negotiation records, client data, or agent actuation controls are exposed.

systems.name: SCEN.OS
systems.description: A scene and context lane for surfaces, rooms, ambient state, and public-safe presentation.
systems.authorityBoundary: No private scene state, device telemetry, or control surfaces are exposed.

systems.name: HORUS / Decksmith
systems.description: Public-facing artifact, deck, and observer lane for reports and structured outputs.
systems.publicSummary: Preview concept connected to Studio and Doctrine.
systems.authorityBoundary: No internal agent orchestration, sensitive decks, or private client artifacts are exposed.

systems.name: KAIR.OS
systems.description: A timing, cadence, and execution lane for operator-visible service and device workflows.
systems.publicSummary: Internal/private. Not part of the public portal.
systems.authorityBoundary: No hardware control, private device state, or command execution surfaces are public.

systems.name: Future Systems
systems.description: Placeholder for future public systems as they become safe to describe.
systems.authorityBoundary: No future private authority is implied by this public placeholder.

publicBeta.localFirstPosture: Local-first preview lane. Installer and portable builds are public beta artifacts; private console functions are not exposed.
publicBeta.betaWarning: Public beta software. Use non-critical test archives first and keep original files under your own custody.
